movie.title: My Dearest Assassin
movie.originalTitle: เลือดรักนักฆ่า
movie.overview: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Hunted from childhood for her ultra-rare blood type, a young woman protected by a secretive clan of assassins takes up arms alongside the man she loves when the syndicate that destroyed her past resurfaces.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After her parents are murdered for her rare blood type, young Lhan is rescued and hidden away inside the warehouse headquarters of House 89, an elite Thai assassin clan. Sheltered for years, she forms a deep bond with Pran, the heir to the syndicate, while another loyal orphan, M, silently protects her. When the ruthless crime lord and deadly mercenaries who targeted her childhood discover her whereabouts, House 89 transforms into a bloody battlefield. Refusing to remain a helpless target, Lhan decides to train and fight alongside her found family to secure their shared future.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In this Thai action-drama, a young girl named Lhan is born with a remarkably rare blood type that makes her the ultimate target for a powerful crime lord who requires constant transfusions. After a ruthless mercenary team slaughters her parents to claim her, members of House 89, a rival secret assassin clan, intervene and bring Lhan to safety. Confined to House 89's fortress-like headquarters for her own protection, Lhan spends years in hiding, growing up alongside Pran, the clan leader's son, and M, another loyal orphan. Over time, a quiet romance develops between Lhan and Pran, while M silently harbors his own feelings but vows to defend them both at all costs. When the dangerous hunter who killed her family finally tracks Lhan down, he launches a full-scale assault on House 89 to capture her for his master. The assault lays waste to their sanctuary and claims the lives of many within their found family, leaving the survivors with nowhere left to run. Driven by love and a desire for survival, Lhan refuses to remain a passive captive or flee any longer. Under intense pressure, she undergoes brutal combat training with small blades to stand ground with Pran and M. In a series of high-octane battles, the trio engages in a deadly war against their relentless pursuers to dismantle the syndicate and earn their freedom.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: 'My Dearest Assassin' is a Thai action romance that follows Lhan, a young woman whose rare blood type has made her a high-value commodity for a ruthless criminal syndicate. Rescued as a child after a tragedy, she is raised within the secluded sanctuary of House 89, an underground assassin clan. Living in constant protection, Lhan forms strong emotional bonds with the clan's heirs, Pran and M, eventually falling in love with Pran. However, when an old enemy discovers her hiding place, House 89 becomes a lethal battleground. Forced to choose between remaining a hidden captive or standing up to her pursuers, Lhan vows to master combat and fight alongside her found family to protect the life and love she has built.
